name: Build report
description: Build the full VMRay report for sample IDs or submission IDs: analyses, VTIs, MITRE ATT&CK, IOCs, classifications, threat names and screenshots per sample, including child samples.

sample_ids.description: VMRay sample IDs — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get samples by hash.
sample_ids.title: Sample Ids

submission_ids.description: VMRay submission IDs — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Submit URL sample. Each is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_ids` is empty.
submission_ids.title: Submission Ids

max_recursion_depth.description: The maximum depth of recursive samples which will be analyzed in the report. 0 disables recursion.
max_recursion_depth.title: Max Recursion Depth

ioc_severity_filter.description: Restrict which IOC severities are fetched from VMRay. Allowed values: 'malicious', 'suspicious'. Add exactly one to filter server-side; leave empty (or add both) to fetch both severities.
ioc_severity_filter.title: Ioc Severity Filter

analysis_verdict_filter.description: Analysis verdicts to include in the report. Allowed values: 'malicious', 'suspicious', 'clean'. Leave empty to include all analyses, including those with an unknown verdict. Note: Adding all three allowed values is NOT the same as leaving empty — it still excludes analyses with unknown verdicts.
analysis_verdict_filter.title: Analysis Verdict Filter

include_screenshots.description: If set to true, the report includes the screenshots of the submitted URL or looked-up hash (the top-level samples only — never of their child samples).
include_screenshots.title: Include Screenshots

results.description:
Only a summary travels inline. The report itself — screenshots included — can be megabytes, far over
Sekoia's limit on action arguments (SYM216), so it is written to data_path and passed on as a file.

report_path.description: Path (relative to data_path) of the full report JSON — give it to Render report and Extract IOCs as `report_path`.
report_path.title: Report Path

errors.description: Samples that could not be fetched at all, keyed by sample_id — or by 'submission:<id>' when the submission itself could not be resolved to a sample.
errors.title: Errors

results.title: BuildReportResults
